Triple Zero'' |author=[[Karen Traviss]] |cover artist=[[Greg Knight]] |illustrator= |editor= |publisher=[[Del Rey]] |early release= |release date=[[February 28]], [[2006]]{{SWArchive|url=eu/lit/novel/f20060228/index.html|text=''Republic Commando: Triple Zero'' Excerpt}} |intl release= |rereleased= |media type=Paperback |pages=393 |isbn=9780345490094 |isbn2= |isbn3= |timeline=[[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' (367-395 days ABG) |series=''[[Republic Commando]]'' |preceded by=''[[The Clone Wars: No Prisoners]]'' |followed by=''[[Clone Wars Gambit: Stealth]]'' }} {{Quote|It's about exploitation, hope, dignity, and identity; it's about what's left inside when everything is taken from you.|Karen Traviss, on ''Republic Commando: Triple Zero''|{{Amazon|url=gp/blog/A3HJJL4GN2L432|text=Karen Traviss' Amazon Blog|date=2006-02-28}}}} '''''Republic Commando: Triple Zero''''' is the second novel in the [[Republic Commando|''Republic Commando'' series]] written by [[Karen Traviss]] and set [[21 BBY/Legends|one year after]] the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]]. It tells the story of [[Omega Squad]], [[Delta Squad/Legends|Delta Squad]], a unit of [[Null-class Advanced Recon Commando|Null ARC troopers]], and their [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[General/Legends|Generals]] [[Etain Tur-Mukan]] and [[Bardan Jusik]] as they pursue a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] terror group along the [[Skylane/Legends|skylanes]] and underworld of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], known to [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] as Triple Zero for its [[Galactic coordinates/Legends|galactic chart coordinates]]. The book contains a short glossary defining ''[[Star Wars]]'', [[Mando'a/Legends|Mando'a]], and military terms. The [[Del Rey]] printing also contains the [[List of short stories|short story]] ''[[Omega Squad: Targets]]'', originally published in [[Star Wars Insider 81|''Star Wars Insider'' #81]], and a preview of ''[[Legacy of the Force: Betrayal]]''. The UK and Australian release printed under the [[Orbit (imprint)|Orbit imprint]] includes the Mando'a glossary, however does not include ''Omega Squad: Targets'' or the preview of ''Betrayal''.
